**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted

## Definition
A strategy to compress or bypass the traditional Observe-Orient-Decide-Act cycle using autonomous, pre-computed or in-network decision pathways. For TCC/iNEST, breaking the OODA loop demands low-latency, topology-aware data flow and neuromorphic decision elements embedded in the network fabric.
